cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 ether-sulfate chassis; defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 with two prominent buffers (Coco-Glucoside@3, Cocamidopropyl Betaine@4) and no reinforcing strong anionic (C4, C1). Counter-signals (refatting Glyceryl Oleate@8, waxy lipid@6) point lighter but never move the convention; two early buffers make the call robust.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: see rationale (counter-signals recorded there; convention value unchanged by claims, 3.2)

conditioningLevel.rationale: High (provisional formula call): a rich architecture under W-RICH for conditioning, read with E3: prominent payload_lipid Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil@6 converging with prominent cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@9, plus Glyceryl Oleate@8 and a deliberate humectant route (Glycerin@12, Panthenol@13, Sodium Hyaluronate@18). C2 itself is not met (no separate pearlizing/fatty route; the lipid cannot fill both the silicone slot and the fatty route), so high rests on the Section 5 high anchor via W-RICH. Counter-signal: single cationic, no silicone, no pearlizer; moderate is the realistic neighbor.
